# Veep

> Veep places vetted senior operators inside founder-led companies to own the work that can't wait. Matched in 72 hours. Deployed in under 10 days. 30-day fit guarantee.

Veep is an invite-only network of operating partners — not a marketplace, staffing firm, or consulting body shop. Operators embed to own critical work across finance, GTM, operations, product, people, fundraising, and strategy.

## Offers (public)

- Advisory — from $3k/month
- Sprint — from $25k/scope
- Operator — from $15k/month
- Pod — from $30k/month
- Portfolio Roster — $75k/year (PE / family offices / holdcos / multi-company founders; usage billed by SOW)
